full_prompt_en: A square interior photograph looks straight down a richly ornamented hall where large striped arches repeat into the distance above a polished reddish-brown floor. The upper frame is dominated by the nearest horseshoe-shaped arch, its alternating pale stone and warm brown bands set into densely carved dark surfaces. Through it, a second arch and then several smaller arches align toward a dim opening at the far center, creating a strong tunnel of gradually shrinking curves. Tall light stone columns stand on both sides of the central aisle, each topped by a darker sculpted capital. The left wall contains a bright side opening and a smaller arch lit by warm lamps; the right wall is deeper in shadow, but its carved surface and blue-gray patterned lower panels remain visible. The long floor begins at the front edge and narrows toward the rear, mirroring the arches with soft, broken reflections of pale columns and warm light. Ornament covers the wall faces and intrados in fine granular detail, from tiny repeating motifs to broader geometric bands, without turning the whole image into a flat pattern. The viewpoint is at eye level in the middle of the passage, making symmetry and perspective the central experience. Warm light enters from the left and from deeper within the hall, striking parts of the columns and floor while the near ceiling and right recesses stay dark. The contrast is substantial but softened by reflected light, so the many overlapping openings are still readable. Brown, honey gold, aged ivory, and muted blue-gray form a restrained palette. The overall composition pulls the eye through a deep sequence of luminous arches, balancing ornate surface density with a quiet, orderly central path.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形室内照片从正面望向一座华丽长厅，巨大的条纹拱券在光亮的红棕色地面上方不断向远处重复。最近的一道马蹄形拱占据画面上部，浅色石料与暖棕色条带交替，嵌在深色且雕饰繁密的表面中。透过它，第二道拱及随后几道更小的拱对准远方中央的幽暗开口，形成逐渐缩小的曲线长廊。高大的浅色石柱立在中央通道两旁，柱顶是较深的雕刻柱头。左墙有明亮的侧向开口和受暖灯照亮的小拱；右墙更深地落在阴影中，但雕花表面和蓝灰色纹样墙裙仍然可见。长长的地面从前缘延伸并向后收窄，以浅色柱子和暖光柔和破碎的倒影呼应上方拱券。细密装饰覆盖墙面和拱内侧，从小型重复纹样到较宽的几何带都有，却没有让整个画面变成平板图案。视点处于通道中央的平视高度，对称与透视成为最主要的体验。暖光从左侧和厅堂深处进入，照到部分柱面与地面，近处天花和右侧凹处仍深暗。反差明显，却被反射光柔化，因此许多重叠的开口依然可辨。棕色、蜂蜜金、古旧象牙白和柔和蓝灰构成克制的配色。整体构图引导视线穿过一道道明亮拱券的深处，在华丽表面密度与安静有序的中央路径之间取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: A detailed photographic treatment turns repeated curved bands into a deep, centered perspective. Warm ivory alternates with honey brown and dark umber along the major edges, while muted blue-gray patterning provides a cool lower counterweight. Fine granular relief occupies the broad surfaces, but smoother light-catching areas and a glossy lower plane prevent the density from becoming uniform. Successive rounded openings shrink toward a shared vanishing point, giving a strong visual pulse and clear spatial depth. Side light and small warm sources illuminate selected intervals; recessed upper and side areas remain dark, and broken reflections carry the highlights forward. The palette is aged and restrained rather than vivid. Precise symmetry, tactile detail, and soft luminous transitions give the image a contemplative grandeur.
style_prompt_zh: 细节充足的摄影表现把重复曲线色带组织成深远的中央透视。暖象牙白与蜂蜜棕、深褐沿主要边缘交替，柔和蓝灰纹理在下方提供冷色平衡。宽阔表面布满细粒浮雕，但更平滑的受光区域与光亮的下方平面使密度不至于均匀一片。接连的圆形开口朝共同消失点缩小，形成强烈的视觉脉动与明确纵深。侧光和少量暖光源照亮选定间隔；上方及侧边内凹处仍深暗，破碎倒影把高光带向前景。配色古旧而克制，并不鲜艳。精确对称、可触的细节和柔和明暗过渡赋予画面沉思般的宏伟感。
theme_en: An ornate hall of repeating striped arches and polished floor
theme_zh: 拱券连绵、地面光亮的华丽长厅
name: Mudejar architecture
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
